verdict.rationale: GitBook has a dedicated 'LLM-ready docs' feature page and references an llms-full.txt variant in docs, and a live probe confirms https://gitbook.com/llms.txt actually returns 200 with real content, corroborating the vendor claim. Missing for 10: direct probe confirmation of the llms-full.txt variant and evidence it's automatically enabled across arbitrary customer-published sites, not just gitbook.com itself.
